Job Description:

GDIT is seeking a Cybersecurity Engineer to support the United States Postal Service (USPS) Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) Operations organization. The candidate will apply expert level AI/ML analytic approaches to large volume of data from disparate sources to uncover cybersecurity threats and fraud schemes against the organization. Leverage Databricks to develop analytic solutions using Python, SQL, and R to create, interpret, visualize, and report on complex data to stakeholders at all levels. Responds to ad hoc requests from stakeholders to investigate concerns. Responsible for working across business units to identify, collect, aggregate, analyze new data sources, advance the team’s mission, and reduce the time needed to deliver analytical insights. Responsible for highlighting and analyzing gaps in USPS systems and processes, as well as recommending remediation solutions to more effectively deter cybersecurity threats and fraudulent activity.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED

Education:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering or other IT/security related major; or equivalent experience
  • NOTE: If resources do not have a relevant college degree, an additional 4 years of relevant work experience is required.

Required skills:

  • 8+ years relevant experience
  • Applicant must be an expert with data science and AI/ML concepts used for fraud detection. Demonstrated expertise in AI/ML solution development, data science practice, data strategy and governance, and customer and stakeholder engagement – all developed over many years of client work delivering solutions.
  • Ability to design AI-powered solutions, integrating large language models, computer vision, and advanced analytics into secure, high-performing environments
  • Ability to direct specialized teams comprising of data scientists, data engineers, and business intelligence specialists driving key AI and advanced technology solutions across secure environments.
  • Manages delivery across multiple engagements including business intelligence, technology and tradecraft, financial operations, workforce analytics, cyber, artificial intelligence, risk management, and product development to enhance organizational performance (Python, SQL, Tableau, AWS).
  • Advanced skills applying AI/ML tools to accelerate business activities including but not limited to programming and script development.

Expert level knowledge of:

  • AI/ML Solution Architecture
  • Data Science and Advanced Analytics
  • Technology Strategy and Implementation
  • Data Strategy and Governance
  • MLOps and Model Lifecycle Management
  • Azure Databricks
  • Python, SQL, R development

Security Clearance Level:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance and successfully pass a thorough Government background screening process requiring the completion of detailed forms and fingerprinting.
  • This position has a U.S. residency requirement. The USPS security clearance process requires the selected candidate to have resided in the U.S. (including U.S. Territories) for the last five years as follows:
    • U.S. Citizens cannot have left the U.S. (including U.S. Territories) for longer than 6 months consecutively in the last 3 years (unless they meet certain exceptions).
    • Non-U.S. Citizens cannot have left the U.S. (including U.S. Territories) for longer than 90 days consecutively in the last 3 years.

Location:

  • Remote
  • Morrisville, NC
  • Falls Church, VA
  • Eagan, MN

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE:

  • Comprehensive health and wellness packages
  • Internal mobility team dedicated to helping you own your career

GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. jobs.title: Senior Kubernetes Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Peraton OverviewPeraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy.
jobs.description:
Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking an experienced Senior Kubernetes Engineer to support development, modernization, and migration of containerized and agentic workloads in a government multi-cloud environment with 70+ customer tenants and growing.

The applicant must have extensive engineering experience and deep Kubernetes and Azure expertise, including designing and leading implementation of container-platform requirements and architecture on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), as well as standing up and operating Agentic Runtime for Kubernetes (ARK) to host AI-agent workloads. The Senior Kubernetes Engineer will serve as a technical escalation point, drive root cause analysis on complex incidents, and provide mentorship and knowledge sharing across engineering teams. A passion for performance, strong desire for quality conformance, and attention to detail are prerequisites for this position.

Location: Remote

Work Hours: This position requires working online from 8:00 AM Eastern to 5:00 PM Eastern

Day to Day Roles and Responsibilities:

Incident Response and Troubleshooting

  • Serve as the Tier 3 escalation point for complex incidents and outages across the Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and ARK agentic-runtime environment
  • Lead investigation and resolution of issues across the Kubernetes stack including AKS clusters, the control plane, CNI networking, ingress, CSI storage, and workload scheduling, as well as the ARK control plane and its Custom Resources (Agents, Models, Teams, Tools, and Queries)
  • Drive root cause analysis on high-severity incidents and own implementation of solutions to prevent recurrence
  • Manage high-priority incident communications with stakeholders, leadership, and affected tenants

Platform Monitoring and Optimization

  • Define and enforce observability standards across tenant clusters using Azure Monitor, Managed Prometheus, Container Insights, Azure Log Analytics, and OpenTelemetry, including the agent-level telemetry emitted by ARK
  • Lead proactive identification and mitigation of cluster, node-pool, and workload risks before they impact tenants
  • Analyze performance, cost, and capacity trends and architect optimizations to improve stability, efficiency, and security at scale

Kubernetes and ARK Platform Engineering

  • Lead management and maintenance of Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters and the ARK agentic runtime across a 70+ tenant environment
  • Deploy, upgrade, and operate ARK on Kubernetes — managing its CRDs, controllers, and model and tool integrations (including MCP servers) to host AI agents declaratively and provider-agnostically
  • Ensure all tenant resources are secure, FedRAMP compliant, and continuously optimized, enforcing Kubernetes RBAC, network policy, and Azure workload identity
  • Partner with the Architecture team to design solutions aligned with the Azure Well-Architected Framework and Kubernetes best practices, and own and enforce Change Management procedures across the team

Collaboration, Mentorship, and Knowledge Sharing

  • Serve as technical lead for incident intake, triage prioritization, and team workload management
  • Mentor and train Tier 2 engineers on Kubernetes and agentic-runtime operations; lead knowledge transfer sessions to build team capability
  • Drive improvements in team metrics and service delivery in coordination with the Service Delivery Manager and Product Owner
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of incident response procedures, architecture decisions, and lessons learned

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree and 8 years of experience or a Masters degree and 6 years of experience or an Associates degree and 10 year of experience or a High School diploma/equivalent and 12 years of experience.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a DHS Public Trust clearance.
  • Engineering and systems analysis experience, with a deep hands-on focus on Kubernetes in production
  • Extensive hands-on expertise operating Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and the broader Kubernetes stack — control plane, CNI networking, ingress, CSI storage, RBAC, Helm, and workload scheduling
  • Hands-on experience deploying and operating Agentic Runtime for Kubernetes (ARK) or comparable Kubernetes-native agent or operator platforms built on the CRD-plus-controller pattern (e.g., Argo), including ARK Custom Resources (Agents, Models, Teams, Tools, and Queries) and MCP/A2A integration
  • Proven experience leading incident management and root cause analysis in large-scale, multi-tenant government environments, with deep knowledge of FedRAMP compliance and Kubernetes and Azure security best practices
  • Strong leadership, communication, and technical documentation skills; ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and senior stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD), plus Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) or Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
  • Proficiency with GitOps and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, Helm, and Argo CD or Flux) and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions)
  • Advanced scripting with Python, PowerShell, or Go for automation and remediation, including use of the ARK Python SDK (ark-sdk)
  • Experience integrating LLM providers (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or local models) behind an agentic runtime

Target Salary Range

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

Application Statements

The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - Finance
jobs.excerpt: Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure.
jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you’ll be responsible for:

Circle has made its reputation on being compliant and transparent. That reputation rests on data that is right.

As a Senior Data Engineer at Circle, you'll own the pipelines and data models that our product, treasury, finance, accounting and compliance teams depend on to meet their reporting and regulatory requirements and to run the business day to day. You'll work with large-scale on-chain and internal data and turn it into datasets that people can trust, explain and defend. You'll also have the chance to shape how we think about data reliability, so that the most important information we track is well organized, well monitored, and understandable to the people who rely on it. The right candidate will join a team of passionate engineers who care about data reliability, and your work will support our mission to be a world-class company driven by data. If you have a lot of attention to detail, get bothered when the numbers don't tie together, are excited to learn from our expert finance, accounting and treasury partners, and want to help people understand how our systems really work, we would love to talk to you.


What you'll work on:

  • Partner with product engineering, finance, accounting, treasury, data analytics, and compliance teams to understand how new products and regulations will affect the data we need, and work with them to design the data requirements, models, business logic and pipelines that let us track and verify that we are meeting our obligations.
  • Develop a strong understanding of how the business thinks about its money and its customers' balances, including custody, reserves and reconciliation, and partner with those teams to make the inner workings of our data transparent.
  • Build the frameworks and systems that help us see when something might be going wrong, such as reconciliation, data quality checks, and alerting. Lead the charge to fix the immediate problem, then design solutions that keep it from happening again.
  • Work with on-chain data at scale, ingesting and modeling data from multiple blockchains and handling the realities of that data, such as reorgs, late or missing records and upstream schema changes.
  • Work with analytics and data science colleagues, and with the teams that consume your data, to make sure what you ship is documented, trustworthy and fits how it will be used. Reframe requests into better data products and push back early when a request isn't well scoped.
  • Build scalable automated solutions using SQL, Python, orchestration and transformation tooling, and AI.
  • Review code, models and designs, and mentor junior engineers.
  • Occasionally share your work with larger audiences to educate them on the inner workings of our data and financial systems.

You will aspire to our four core values:


  • Multistakeholder - you have dedication and commitment to our customers, shareholders, employees and families and local communities.
  • Mindful - you seek to be respectful, an active listener and to pay attention to detail.
  • Driven by Excellence - you are driven by our mission and our passion for customer success which means you relentlessly pursue excellence, that you do not tolerate mediocrity and you work intensely to achieve your goals.
  • High Integrity - you seek open and honest communication, and you hold yourself to very high moral and ethical standards. You reject manipulation, dishonesty and intolerance.

What you’ll bring to Circle:

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical field (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Finance or similar), or equivalent experience.
  • 6+ years of experience building and operating production data pipelines and models.
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python, and experience with a modern data stack: a cloud data warehouse, an orchestrator such as Airflow, and a transformation tool such as dbt.
  • Experience owning a data domain end to end and being the person partners come to when something breaks or needs to change.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain clearly to non-technical audiences how the systems you own and design work.
  • Strong collaboration skills that allow you to make sure that product engineering, data, finance, accounting, treasury and compliance are all on the same page about requirements and expectations.
  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability: when a number looks wrong or a pipeline breaks, you take the lead in triaging it, investigating the root cause and driving it to resolution, and you keep cross-functional partners informed until it is fixed.
  • Experience with blockchain data, financial services, banking or other regulated industries is a plus, but not required.

Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

Base Pay Range: $152,500 - $205,000

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.

Should you require accommodations or assistance in our interview process because of a disability, please reach out to for support. We respect your privacy and will connect with you separately from our interview process to accommodate your needs.

jobs.description:
Pronunciation: a:rine [uh-reen]. Noun: Arine is a name of Basque origin meaning "light." Arine illuminates the possibilities with medication management to deliver comprehensive economic and health outcomes.

Based in San Francisco, Arine is a rapidly growing healthcare technology and clinical services company with a mission to ensure individuals receive the safest and most effective treatments for their unique and evolving healthcare needs.

Frequently, medications cause more harm than good. Incorrect drugs and doses costs the US healthcare system over $528 billion in waste, avoidable harm, and hospitalizations each year. Arine is redefining what excellent healthcare looks like by solving these issues through our software platform (SaaS). We combine cutting edge data science, machine learning, AI, and deep clinical expertise to introduce a patient-centric view to medication management, and develop and deliver personalized care plans on a massive scale for patients and their care teams.

Arine is committed to improving the lives and health of complex patients that have an outsized impact on healthcare costs and have traditionally been difficult to identify and address. These patients face numerous challenges including complicated prescribing issues across multiple medications and providers, medication challenges with many chronic diseases, and patient issues with access to care. Backed by leading healthcare investors and collaborating with top healthcare organizations and providers, we deliver recommendations and facilitate clinical interventions that lead to significant, measurable health improvements for patients and cost savings for customers.

Why is Arine a Great Place to Work?:

Outstanding Team and Culture - Our shared mission unites and motivates us to do our best work. We have a relentless passion and commitment to the innovation required to be the market leader in medication intelligence.

Making a Proven Difference in Healthcare - We are saving patient lives, and enabling individuals to experience improved health outcomes, including significant reductions in hospitalizations and cost of care.

Market Opportunity - Arine is backed by leading healthcare investors and was founded to tackle one of the largest healthcare problems today. Non-optimized medications therapies which cost the US 275,000 lives and $528 billion annually.

Momentum That Matters - In just over eight years, Arine has grown into one of the fastest-growing healthcare AI companies, serving more than 45 million members through partnerships with leading health plans nationwide. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list for two consecutive years, we're combining rapid growth with meaningful impact on the quality, cost, and outcomes of care.

The Role:

The Data Services Intern will report to a manager within the Data Services department . This is a hands-on opportunity to transition from academic theory to real-world application. You will assist in translating business needs into technical specifications and building data solutions that directly impact patient outcomes. You will collaborate with other engineers in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

What You’ll be Doing:

  • Data Modeling: Support the development and maintenance of data models to ensure the "single source of truth" for organizational metrics. Monitor the health of pipelines and shadow senior engineers in resolving critical incidents.
    • What you’ll learn: SQL + dbt in our Snowflake data lake; Github source control
  • Requirements Gathering: Shadow stakeholders to learn how business requirements are translated to code. Support the creation and refinement of dashboards and analytical reports to provide stakeholders and customers with insights.
    • What you’ll learn: Business requirements and ticket workflow
  • Documentation: Create and maintain technical documentation for data lineage and reporting processes.
    • What you’ll learn: How to create comprehensive documentation including diagrams
  • Quality Assurance: Perform data validation to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of reports used for clinical interventions.
    • What you’ll learn: unit testing in dbt
  • AI-Assisted Development: We use AI to increase developer velocity and focus our efforts on system design, code review and logic validation.
    • What you’ll learn: Cursor, Claude Code and/or Snowflake Cortex

Who You Are and What You Bring:

  • Academic Background: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • SQL Fundamentals: Strong foundational knowledge of SQL and a desire to apply it to complex, real-world datasets.
  • Engineering Interest:Exposure to (or a strong desire to learn) BI tools (e.g., Amazon QuickSight, Tableau), data processing/ETL tools (e.g., Python, Airflow) and cloud platforms (AWS).
  • Analytical Mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to look at data through a critical lens.
  • Systematic Thinking: An interest in data governance, data lineage, and designing efficient, scalable data workflows.
  • Communication: Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences clearly and concisely.
  • Adaptability: A self-starter who can take initiative, ask the right questions, and thrive in an Agile startup environment.
  • Healthcare Interest: A passion for using technology to improve patient lives (previous healthcare data experience is a plus, but not strictly required).

Internship Perks:

  • Direct Mentorship: Work alongside experienced Software Architects, Clinicians, and Digital Health experts.
  • High Impact: See your work used in real-time to reduce hospitalizations and improve health outcomes.
  • Career Growth: Gain deep insight into the HealthTech industry and the lifecycle of a high-growth SaaS startup. Grow your technical skill set and enhance your resume with real-world projects.

Remote Work Requirements:

  • An established private work area that ensures information privacy
  • Reliable internet capable of low latency with the ability to carry video and voice calls without breaking up
  • This role is remote, but you will be required to come to on-site meetings multiple times per year. This may be during the interview process, onboarding, and for team meetings

Perks:

Joining Arine offers you a dynamic role and the opportunity to contribute to the company's growth and shape its future. You'll have unparalleled learning and growth prospects, collaborating closely with experienced Clinicians, Engineers, Software Architects, and Digital Health Entrepreneurs.

The posted range represents the expected salary for this position and does not include any other potential components of the compensation package, benefits, and perks. Ultimately, the final pay decision will consider factors such as your experience, job level, location, and other relevant job-related criteria. The hourly rate for this position is: $25/hr.

Job Requirements:

  • Ability to pass a background check
  • Must live in and be eligible to work in the United States

Information Security Roles and Responsibilities:

All staff at Arine are expected to be part of its Information Security Management Program and undergo periodic training on Information Security Awareness and HIPAA guidelines. Each user is responsible to maintain a secure working environment and follow all policies and procedures. Upon hire, each person is assigned and must complete trainings before access is granted for their specific role within Arine.

Check our website at This is a unique opportunity to join a growing start-up revolutionizing the healthcare industry!

Arine is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with fairness and respect. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other legally protected status. Our hiring decisions and employment practices are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and join us in our mission.

For security purposes, official communications from Arine will only come from @arine.io email addresses or through our authorized platforms, including Rippling, TurboCheck, Jobma, and Checkr. If you receive a message claiming to be from Arine through another source, or if you have concerns about its authenticity, please contact us before sharing personal information or taking any action. We will never request payment or sensitive personal information (copy of government-issued ID, social security number, bank details, etc.) during the recruiting process.

Note to Recruitment Agencies: We appreciate your interest in finding talent for Arine, but please be advised that we do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. jobs.description:
About Pantheon

Pantheon WebOps Platform powers the open web, running more than 300,000 sites in the cloud for customers including Google, Princeton, Salesloft and Doctors Without Borders. Every day, thousands of developers and marketers create, iterate, and scale WordPress and Drupal sites to reach billions of people globally. Pantheon’s multitenant, container-based platform enables organizations to manage all of their websites from a single dashboard. Organizations including Clorox and the United Nations drive results through accelerated development and real-time publishing using Pantheon’s collaborative workflows.

The Role

The Senior Manager, Technical Support Engineering leads the operating model that helps Technical Support solve complex customer problems with speed, depth, and consistency. This role owns the systems, standards, and partnerships that allow a high-performing global team to do its best work.

The role includes leadership of specialized capability for complex escalations, platform reliability, proactive monitoring, on-call engineering tasks, and structured partnership with Engineering. This is an operational leadership role. The successful candidate will look for constraints in the system, identify practical solutions, and build repeatable ways of working. They will use data, customer signals, and team feedback to improve service without creating unnecessary processes.

What you will own

Global operating model

  • Lead Technical Support Engineering operations across multiple regions and locations
  • Design and maintain a follow-the-sun model with clear regional ownership, handoffs, on-call coverage, and escalation paths.
  • Establish operating cadences that make work visible, decisions timely, and ownership clear.
  • Ensure coverage, workload, and priorities match customer risk and business needs.
  • Build the mechanisms that allow the team to operate effectively across time zones without relying on constant manager intervention.

Operational excellence and continuous improvement

  • Diagnose operational problems at the system level, including unclear ownership, weak handoffs, avoidable escalations, capacity constraints, and inconsistent follow-through.
  • Design simple, durable solutions that improve speed and quality without adding process for its own sake.
  • Use service data, ticket trends, customer feedback, incident reviews, and team input to prioritize improvements.
  • Own the operating procedures, runbooks, playbooks, review mechanisms, and reporting needed to make the function scalable.
  • Establish clear standards for escalation quality, customer communication, Engineering follow-up, incident participation, and documentation.
  • Create feedback loops that show whether a change improved the customer experience and the team’s ability to deliver.
  • Use automation and AI thoughtfully to reduce repetitive work, improve signal detection, and increase the team’s capacity for complex issues.

Customer and cross-functional leadership

  • Act as an escalation leader for high-impact customer issues and incidents.
  • Ensure customers receive clear ownership, timely updates, and technically credible guidance.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Account teams, Product, Professional Services, and Engineering on complex customer situations.
  • Translate team performance, customer risk, and recurring technical themes into clear recommendations for senior leadership.
  • Connect Support execution to customer trust, retention, expansion readiness, and the company’s ability to deliver differentiated support offerings.

Team leadership and development

  • Build and sustain a high-performing team with clear standards for judgment, ownership, technical depth, and customer care.
  • Set clear expectations for managers, team leads, and engineers, then give them the context and tools to meet those expectations.
  • Coach leaders to solve operational problems independently rather than escalating every constraint upward.
  • Develop technical depth in platform troubleshooting, incident response, observability, and customer communication.
  • Own performance management, career development, succession planning, and retention for the function.
  • Make thoughtful decisions about readiness, role fit, and team structure with clarity and care.
  • Protect the conditions that allow strong engineers to do deep work while maintaining reliable customer coverage.
  • Build an environment where people raise risks early, challenge weak processes constructively, and follow through on commitments.

Measures of success

The Senior Manager will establish baselines early and use the measures below to drive decisions and continuous improvement.

  • Faster and more consistent acknowledgement and resolution of high-severity issues.
  • Improved quality and actionability of Engineering handoffs.
  • Fewer avoidable escalations and stronger trust from Engineering in Support triage.
  • Reliable follow-the-sun and on-call coverage across all three regions.
  • Clear ownership and timely follow-up throughout complex customer issues.
  • More recurring platform patterns surfaced with supporting data and converted into corrective action.
  • Meaningful contributions to post-incident reviews, reliability improvements, and reusable runbooks.
  • Strong customer outcomes on the most complex and highest-risk interactions.
  • A team that is engaged, technically capable, and able to operate with increasing autonomy.
  • Documented workflow improvements that increase capacity or reduce avoidable effort through automation and AI.

What we are looking for

  • Significant experience leading technical support, escalation support, site reliability, platform operations, or a related function in a SaaS, cloud, or web infrastructure environment.
  • Experience leading globally distributed or follow-the-sun teams.
  • A demonstrated record of improving support operations through better ownership, process design, metrics, and cross-functional execution.
  • Experience managing high-performing technical teams and developing managers or team leads.
  • Strong incident and escalation management experience, including customer communication during high-impact events.
  • Experience partnering with Engineering and Product to investigate defects, improve reliability, and address systemic issues.
  • Strong analytical judgment and the ability to turn operational data into clear priorities and decisions.
  • Experience building or improving service metrics, dashboards, operating reviews, and reporting for senior stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain complex technical issues to non-technical audiences.
  • Working knowledge of observability, logs, traces, incident management, ticketing systems, and technical knowledge management.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Drupal, and Next.js, or comparable web application and cloud infrastructure environments.
  • Experience using automation or AI to improve support workflows, knowledge access, triage, or operational visibility.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical, business, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What We Offer

We have all the usual perks and benefits but what we can really offer you is a fantastic work environment powered by an amazing team.

  • Industry competitive compensation and equity plan
  • Flexible time off, sick days, and 13 paid holidays
  • Comprehensive medical insurance including Health, Dental and Vision
  • Paid parental leave (plus fertility, adoption and other family planning benefits)
  • In-office workspace (San Francisco & Chicago)
  • Monthly allowance for wellness, reading and access to LinkedIn Learning for continued development
  • Events and activities both team-based and company wide that inspire, educate and cultivate

The base salary for this position is $164,400.00 – $205,500.00 annually for employees based in San Francisco and New York, and $147,700.00 – $184,600.00 annually for all other U.S. locations. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including role scope, relevant experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and equity.

Job Title: Analytics Engineer - OpenData EMEA (Remote)

Job Location: Barcelona, Spain

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva OpenData Commercial supports the industry by providing reference data across the complete healthcare ecosystem, to support commercial sales execution, compliance, and business analytics.
We drive value to our customers through constant innovation, using cloud-based solutions and state-of-the-art technologies to deliver product excellence and customer success.
The analyst engineer role will create maintenance jobs to transform, clean and validate data from a variety of sources. The data is handed over to our data platform for processing using Python.
The role has a significant impact on customer success, as it is ensuring the freshness, availability and quality of data for our customers. In addition to data acquisition and modeling of data, the role will work on classic analytical tasks, like ad-hoc reports and visual reporting too.

What You'll Do

    • Configure and maintain robust, scalable crawlers
    • Build reports, ad-hoc and regularly
    • Integrate extracted data into our OpenData platform
    • Implement data quality and observability
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver solutions

Requirements

    • 4+ years of experience as a data analyst using SQL
    • 4+ years of experience as an analytic engineer using Python
    • Strong understanding of good practices, like version control and code reviews
    • Hands on experience building robust and scalable crawlers
    • Solid understanding of data structures (data frames) and data models
    • Experience modeling, transforming and cleaning of raw data

Nice to Have

    • Experience with crawling tools like Mozenda or Zyte
    • Experience with Redshift
    • Experience with Dbt, Polars

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Benefits package including Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), family health insurance and contributions to private pension plans
    • Annual allocations for charitable contributions
    • Fitness reimbursement
    • Work from anywhere

Compensation

    • Total compensation: 45,000 - 95,000 EUR
    • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

jobs.description:
PENN Entertainment, Inc. is North America’s leading provider of integrated entertainment, sports content, and casino gaming experiences. From casinos and racetracks to online gaming, sports betting and entertainment content, we deliver the experiences people want, how and where they want them.

We’re always on the lookout for those who are passionate about creating and delivering cutting-edge online gaming and sports media products. Whether it’s through Hollywood Casino, theScore Bet Sportsbook, or theScore media app, we’re excited to push the boundaries of what’s possible. These state-of-the-art platforms are powered by proprietary in-house technology, a key component of PENN’s omnichannel gaming and entertainment strategy.

When you join PENN Entertainment’s digital team, you’ll not only work on these cutting-edge platforms through theScore and PENN Interactive, but you’ll also be part of a company that truly cares about your career growth. We’re committed to supporting you as you expand your skills and explore new opportunities.

With locations throughout North America, you can build a future at PENN Entertainment wherever you are. If you want to challenge conventions in gaming, media and entertainment, we want to talk to you.

About the Role & TeamThe Business Intelligence Engineer investigates and disseminates centralized data sources to expand the reliability and scope of the corporate Enterprise Data Warehouse as a source of truth among supported teams. The incumbent is responsible for distilling transactional data down to valuable and relatable KPIs for business partners in areas such as Marketing, Gaming, Hotel, Food and Beverage, Finance, and Human Resources. 

About the Work

As a key member of our team, you will:

  • Provide data direction and education to property analyst teams
  • Work as gatekeeper for all data related inquiries and assure accurate delivery/usage
  • Help facilitate data for advanced analytics/modeling requirements
  • Maintain and escalate data quality practices including local oversight, risk mitigation and resolution procedures
  • Identify, collaborate, and present key data relationships and KPIs that allow the business leaders to better see and understand their operations 
  • Monitor data performance and SLA thresholds to assure end-user adoption
  • Work with stakeholders across different areas on new data requirements and definitions
  • Present data findings through multiple qualitative communication platforms
  • Other duties as required

About the You

  • University degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Business, or related field.
  • You possess a minimum of 3+ years of experience in data modeling or analytics
  • You bring hands-on expertise with our technology stack: SQL, Tableau and relational databases
  • Familiarity with Tableau or other BI platforms is required
  • Awareness of machine learning languages and data modeling (Python) is a plus
  • You excel in managing relationships with both internal and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment and transparency throughout project lifecycles.
  • Strong problem solving, organizational, and prioritization skills
  • Proven ability to communicate with technical and non-technical management    
  • Interest in Sports, casinos or consumer products

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Fun, relaxed work environment
  • Education and conference reimbursements.
  • Opportunities for career progression and mentoring others
Salary Range
$80,000—$115,000 USD

Penn Interactive is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Penn Interactive provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Additionally, Penn Interactive provides best-in-class benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality – to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life.
